sources_summary: Church Newsroom, "President Oaks Dedicates the Belo Horizonte Brazil Temple": https://newsroom.churchofjesuschrist.org/article/president-oaks-dedicates-belo-horizonte-brazil-temple
method: Every currently-dedicated Brazil temple (12 as of this writing), each with its own exact dedication date, cross-verified against the Church's own chronology and temple-list pages. This is a real, complete count of DEDICATED temples only - temples under construction or merely announced are not counted here (see `under_construction_or_announced` below). No point is interpolated or estimated. Two calendar years (2000, 2022) saw two dedications each, collapsed into one plotted point carrying that year's ending cumulative total - see `temples` for each individual dedication.

under_construction_or_announced.note: Not counted in the chart itself - only dedicated temples are plotted as completed milestones.
